name: Bathyal-Yardang
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a subterranean ocean, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Around the temporal distortion zone, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
